map.基于标准物理与工程公式: Based on standard physical and engineering formulas
map.待机功耗与电费（本页代码口径，电器表勾选累加）：总待机功率=Σ(勾选电器功率×数: Standby power and electricity cost (as implemented on this page, summing the checked appliances in the table): total standby power = Σ(checked appliance power × quantity) (W); daily consumption = total power × daily standby hours ÷ 1000 (kWh); monthly consumption = daily × 30, annual = daily × 365; annual cost = annual consumption × price (CNY), with each detail row listing its annual cost on the same basis. Validation: with nothing checked, prompt "Please check the appliances that are on standby to calculate"; quantity ≤0 or unchecked appliances are excluded; empty price and hours fall back to defaults (0.58 CNY/kWh, 20 hours). Criteria: no fixed grading; the savings amount is shown as the annual cost of turning off all standby power.
